title: Tour payments
summary: List with a filter by type (prepayment, direct payment, allocations), payment details, credit balance and allocations.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Payments
steps.details: Payments from patients: invoice payments and prepayments (money on account that's later applied to invoices).

steps.title: Type
steps.details: Prepayment (on account), direct invoice payment, payment or credit note allocation.

steps.title: Details
steps.details: Amount, payment method, currency, invoice and date.

steps.title: Actions
steps.details: Print the receipt or email it. «Historical» marks payments entered without a cash register.

steps.title: Credit balance
steps.details: Prepayments only: how much is left available to apply to invoices.

steps.title: Allocations
steps.details: Which invoices the prepayment was applied to.
